# Pavāraṇākkhandhaka (Kd 4)

**ID:** Kd 4
**Section:** Khandhaka (kd)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Pavāraṇākkhandhaka
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m2.mul3.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 Automatically computed matches in DharmaNexus align the Pali text directly with the Sanskrit *Pravāraṇāvastu* and the Tibetan *Vinayavastu* (*'dul ba gzhi*) [DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali tradition, DharmaNexus records widespread text reuse (nearly 16,000 matches across 196 texts), sharing extensive procedural formulas particularly with the *Uposathakkhandhaka* (Kd 2) and *Pārivāsikakkhandhaka* (Kd 12), as well as subcommentaries including the *Vinayavinicchaya-ṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. Modern translations include an English rendering by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Full parallels: san-mu-kd3 Pravāraṇāvastu; xct-mu-kd3 Pavāraṇā; lzh-mu-kd3 Pavāraṇā; Lzh Sarv Kd3 Pavāraṇā Khandhaka; Lzh Dg Kd 4 Pavaraṇā Khandhaka; Lzh Mi Kd 4 Pavāraṇā Khandhaka
- Resembling parallels: Lzh Mg Bu Pn4 Vagga 4. Uposatha
- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Uposathakkhandhaka (Kd 2) (§13.1.26–14.4.3 ↔ §34.6.21–36.4.3); Pārivāsikakkhandhaka (Kd 12) (§13.1.67.1–13.1.84 ↔ §1.3.1–1.3.18_1); Vinayapiṭake Vinayavinicchayaṭīkā (Tika Vin11t) (§13.1.67.1–14.1.0 ↔ §3689–3704); Vinayapiṭake Vinayasaṅgaha-aṭṭhakathā (Tika Vin05t) (§1.11.13–1.11.17 ↔ §722_9–723_8); Vinayapiṭake Khuddasikkhā-mūlasikkhā (Tika Vin13t) (§5.3.7–5.3.21 ↔ §1510_0–1512); Cīvarakkhandhaka (Kd 8) (§3.5.3–3.5.23 ↔ §30.2.2_0–30.2.4_3); Mahākhandhaka (Kd 1) (§1.8.3–1.10.6 ↔ §31.3.3–31.5.1); Vinayapiṭake Vinayālaṅkāra-ṭīkā (Tika Vin08t) (§13.1.0–13.1.19 ↔ §1052–1056_4)
- Cross-language matches (DharmaNexus): འདུལ་བ་གཞི། (vinayavastu) (D0001) [bo]; ལས་བརྒྱ་རྩ་གཅིག་པ། (ekottarakarmaśataka) (D4118) [bo]; འདལ་བ་གཞུང་བླམ (vinaya-uttaragrantha) (D0007) [bo]; Poṣadhasthāpanavastu (SA_K01_vinv14_u) [sa]; BO_T08_D4106-1 [bo]; Pravāraṇāvastu (SA_K01_vinv03_u) [sa]; Śayanāsanavastu (SA_K01_vinv15_u) [sa]; Yogācārabhūmi: Śrāvakabhūmi (SA_T06_srabhu_u) [sa]
- [DharmaNexus] DharmaNexus parallel matching engine — Provided automated cross-language alignments with Sanskrit and Tibetan Vinaya texts and Pali-internal reuse data.
- [Banerjee 1979] Anukul Chandra Banerjee, Sarvāstivāda Literature (1979) — Described the narrative setting, purpose, and comparative correspondence between the Pali and Tibetan versions.
- [Frauwallner 1956] Erich Frauwallner, The Earliest Vinaya and the Beginnings of Buddhist Literature (1956) — Demonstrated the structural position of the chapter corresponding to the Pravāraṇāvastu across Vinaya traditions.
